audit_items.title: Does beacon roots system transaction execute before user transactions?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL (Execution Layer) block processing function 'apply_body' and 'process_unchecked_system_transaction', but target workspace contains Prysm, a CL (Consensus Layer) client. EL transaction execution logic belongs in execution clients like Geth, Nethermind, or Besu.

audit_items.title: Does history storage system transaction execute as second operation?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL block processing function 'apply_body' and 'process_unchecked_system_transaction(HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS)', but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). EL transaction execution logic is not present in CL clients.

audit_items.title: Are transactions processed in sequential order within a block?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL block processing function 'apply_body' transaction ordering logic, but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). Transaction execution and ordering is handled by EL clients, not CL clients.

audit_items.title: Are withdrawals processed after all transactions?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL block processing function 'apply_body' and 'process_withdrawals' ordering, but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). While CL handles withdrawal credentials, the EL processes withdrawals as state transitions. This tests EL-specific logic.

audit_items.title: Are general purpose requests processed last in block body?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL block processing function 'apply_body' and 'process_general_purpose_requests', but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). General purpose request processing in EL block execution is not present in CL clients.

audit_items.title: Are request types appended in correct order (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations)?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL 'process_general_purpose_requests' function assembling deposit logs, withdrawal requests, and consolidation requests, but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). Request assembly from EL logs is EL-specific logic.

audit_items.title: Are deposit requests parsed from block output logs (not system transactions)?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL 'parse_deposit_requests' function parsing log entries, but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). EL log parsing and deposit request extraction is EL-specific functionality.

audit_items.title: Are withdrawal and consolidation requests from checked system transactions?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL 'process_checked_system_transaction' function for withdrawal and consolidation request contracts, but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). System transaction execution is EL-specific logic.

audit_items.title: Are blocks with number < 1 rejected?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL 'validate_header' function rejecting blocks with number < 1, but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). EL block header validation is distinct from CL beacon block validation.

audit_items.title: Are block timestamps strictly increasing?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item tests EL 'validate_header' function enforcing strictly increasing timestamps, but target workspace contains Prysm (CL client). While CL also validates timestamps, this specifically tests EL block header validation logic.
